full_name: Pupa Gilbert | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 Physical Sciences Perrin Moorhead Grayson and Bruns Grayson Fellow University of Wisconsin–Madison
bio: Pupa Gilbert is a professor of physics from the University of Wisconsin–Madison (UW–Madison). Her research in biophysics aims to reveal the formation mechanisms of seashells.
